coordinate_convention: Pixel integer [left,top,right,bottom], right/bottom exclusive; Android Rect compatible. Do not split sheets at 50%.
default_view_selection: entries[].active_views is authoritative. u17 original rear is superseded.
scale_note: 미니의 게임 표시 높이는 기본의60%. 다른 개체를 임의로 동일 높이에 맞추지 말 것. 피벗/발 기준점/실기기 검증은 미완료.
review_note: Known issues are inherited review findings, not newly fixed in this archive. No issue listed does not equal final approval. Rejected rear-v2 variants excluded.
